therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with breast cancer receiving chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in Visual Working Memory - Delayed Matching to Sample Test from baseline to 4 weeks post-chemotherapy

results.effect_size: 16/45 improved, 13/45 no change, 16/45 declined on visual working memory test
subgroup_findings: Verbal memory showed improvement in 22/45 participants
Processing speed (TMT Part A) worsened from 27.58 to 32.65 seconds
Executive function (TMT Part B) worsened from 79.42 to 87.53 seconds
Most cognitive domains showed mixed results with some improvement, some decline
results.dose_information: Week 1: 5 mg once daily; Week 2: 5 mg twice daily; Week 3: 5 mg morning/10 mg evening; Week 4+: 10 mg twice daily; Duration: 12-26 weeks depending on chemotherapy regimen

context.duration: 12-26 weeks treatment duration with 4 weeks post-chemotherapy follow-up
